summary: Optional first-party plugin controls and cross-platform Relay source support

Added: Selectable first-party plugin packaging, administrator enable/install controls and focused plugin settings with execution-aware disable safeguards.
Linux tray and user-service packaging plus macOS CLI packaging, native credential backends and explicit session-only credential mode.
Changed: Automation, browser tasks, workflows, reports, notifications and evaluation retain their existing integration contracts behind optional-plugin host checks.
Cross-platform Relay release workflows require their platform signing and notarization prerequisites; source candidates do not imply published platform releases.
